lines.t: Verse 1
The room is quiet, but my mind is loud
I’m standing here beneath the clouds
Every step feels heavy now
And I don’t know how to get out
Pre-Chorus
If You hear me, don’t let go
I’m weaker than I want to show
In this silence, in this night
Stay with me and make it right
Chorus
Hold me close when I’m falling apart
When the night feels heavy on my heart
When the world gets cold and I lose control
Hold me close and don’t let go
Hold me close, I need Your peace
Carry me when I can’t believe
Through the pain and through the cold
Hold me close and don’t let go
Verse 2
I’ve been walking through the rain
Trying not to feel this weight
Smiles hide the hurt inside
But I can’t keep this all behind
Pre-Chorus

I’m weaker than I want to show
In this silence, in this night
Stay with me and make it right

Bridge
Even if I feel unseen
Even if I’m barely breathing
Even if I feel unseen
Even if I’m barely breathing
Stay with me until I’m strong
You can hold me all night long
